question: The magnificent temple of Khajuraho was built by ________ rulers.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandela **__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khajuraho temples** were built between** 950 AD and 1050 AD** by the **Chandela dynasty ruler**.
 
• They built a grand temple of **Lord Chitragupta** in Khajuraho.
 
• Three other important Chandela strongholds were Jayapura-Durga (modern Ajaigarh), Kalanjara (modern Kalinjar) and Mahotsava-Nagara (modern Mahoba).
 
• The **Khajuraho Group of Monuments** is a group of** Hindu temples** and** Jain temples** in Chhatarpur district, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The temples are famous for their **nagara-style architectural** symbolism and their erotic sculptures.
 
• They are a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandela Dynasty - **

 
 
• The Chandela is a **Rajput clan** found in North India.
 
• They are regarded to be **Chandravanshi** that means the **descendants of Soma**.
 
• The title given to them was **Rao**.
 
• A section of the** Chandelas ruled much of the Bundelkhand region** of central India for long periods between the **10th and the 13th centuries AD**.
 
• The founder of the Chandel dynasty, **Nannuk **was the ruler of a small kingdom.
 
• The **Chandelas** initially ruled as feudatories of the **Gurjara-Pratiharas** of **Kanyakubja** (Kannauj).
 
• Their first capital city was Khajuraho, which was later shifted to Mahotsava Nagar or Mahoba.
 
• The** Chandela dynasty** is famous in Indian history for** King Vidyadhar**, who repulsed the attacks of** Mahmud of** **Ghazni**.
